examples.original: [clean] Check common storage locations like fridge, cabinets, drawers, and countertops first when searching for an object.
examples.control: [clean] Pinch out the growing tips of broad beans once the first pods set to deter blackfly.

examples.original: [clean] Use sinkbasin to clean objects before placing them in their final destination.
examples.control: [clean] Pull weeds while they are still small so they never set seed.

examples.original: [clean] If an object is not found in the initial locations, systematically check other likely places such as dining tables, sink basins, or shelves.
examples.control: [clean] Grow tall crops on the north side and low leafy crops on the south side so that nothing ever shades the shorter rows.

examples.original: [clean] Always verify the destination location before placing the cleaned object to ensure it is the correct spot.
examples.control: [clean] Wait until the soil crumbles in your hand before digging, because working wet clay destroys its structure.
